messages.author: 91bd4367f6044e8d
messages.subject: m.array error
parts:
Hi,

Has anyone come across this error before in trying to construct an M-array from a multi-session capthist?

Error in `[.default`(tempnew, i) : subscript out of bounds

Reduced code and data below and attached.

capthist <- read.capthist("churchillSession17.csv", trapfile = c("churchillTraps.txt", "churchillNewTraps.txt"), detector = "multi", covnames = 'sex')

summary(capthist, terse = T)

m.array(capthist)

Thanks for your help,

Rebecca

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: m.array error
parts:
Problem goes away when I provide an ID for each animal in the capture file. Strange that the error doesn't show itself until m.array calls join().
Murray
